notes.title: Progress update!
notes.notes: [p]Hey everyone![/p][p]Work on Nothing Beyond This Point has been ongoing for a while now, but I haven't made any posts in a while! That seems wrong. I should make a post in the form of a progress update! And here we are.[/p][h1]An Area [strike]A[/strike]overview[/h1][p]There's 16 areas planned for NBTP, and of those, 13 are completely done right now! The 14th one is in progress, but it's gonna take a bit longer than most, considering its gimmick is quite... special. Honestly, it's worth playing the game for the 14th area alone.[/p][p]Things that you can look out for now also include, but are absolutely not limited to:[/p][list][*][p]A big fancy puzzle![/p][/*][*][p]Obelisk 2.0, now with less corruption![/p][/*][*][p]Burnable flags![/p][/*][*][p]Killer bosses![/p][/*][*][p]Eyes.[/p][/*][/list][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45284742/0f8256e81c442038ccda4e4f900c9a735a44854a.png"][/img][i]Eyes?[/i][/p][p]What's with the eyes, anyway? ...It's probably fine.[/p][p]I'm constantly going back through areas and improving things. More item animations, additional decoration, improved layouts, and so on. The bigger a game is, the longer it takes to make. But worry not, the enemies, bosses, and their musical tracks are of the highest quality. According to me.[/p][p]The soundtrack will be uploaded to Youtube and get its own 1$ purchase! It'll likely be about 1.5 hours long and I'm sure you'll like most of it.[/p][h1]Marketing Efforts[/h1][p]Speaking about Youtube! Making a game is hard. Making a good game is extremely hard. Marketing a game? Impossible. I'll be a bit transparent about what I'm doing.[/p][p]I'm on a continuous process to scout out Twitch streamers, Youtubers, and other content creators that may like to play Nothing Beyond This Point. I currently have over 100 emails and several Discords to spread the message, but if you know anyone in particular, let me know.[/p][p]I'll also be distributing the game via Steam's Curator Connect system - but only once it's content-complete![/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45284742/da30858a3fd6d49dd370dbbb124784495d46dffe.png"][/img][i]Wait, these statues are still alive? Uh oh.[/i][/p][h1]Are You Still On Track?[/h1][p]Yes, I am still on track. Early 2026 release will most likely happen. Depending on how soon I'll be done with the base content, I may add some bonus things as well! Things that are on the table include:[/p][list][*][p]Boss rush[/p][/*][*][p]The Bestiary[/p][/*][*][p]4 extra bosses, with rewards[/p][/*][*][p]Secret rooms[/p][/*][*][p]Another ending (there's 3 planned so this'll be the 4th)[/p][/*][*][p]Who knows![/p][/*][/list][p]If you buy the game at launch, it'll be complete, but I'll always keep fixing things and will likely add post-launch features too. So don't hesitate! [b]Wishlist Nothing Beyond This Point[/b] and have a jolly good time venturing through the endless Void.[/p][p]But seriously, though, what is it with these eyes?[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45284742/1e27629ec3ce01d6c8b5f60691cadb6357444b3f.png"][/img][i]I feel like I'm not alone anymore.[/i][/p]
